1.web: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”
1.asv: And it came to pass, as he was praying in a certain place, that when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, even as John also taught his disciples.

2.web: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.
2.asv: And he said unto them, When ye pray, say, Father, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come.

3.web: Give us day by day our daily bread.
3.asv: Give us day by day our daily bread.

4.web: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”
4.asv: And forgive us our sins; for we ourselves also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And bring us not into temptation.

5.web: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,
5.asv: And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say to him, Friend, lend me three loaves;

6.web: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’
6.asv: for a friend of mine is come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him;

7.web: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?
7.asv: and he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give thee?

8.web: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.
8.asv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will arise and give him as many as he needeth.

9.web: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.
9.asv: And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.

10.web: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
10.asv: For every one that asketh receiveth; and he that seeketh findeth; and to him that knocketh it shall be opened.

11.web: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?
11.asv: And of which of you that is a father shall his son ask a loaf, and he give him a stone? or a fish, and he for a fish give him a serpent?

12.web: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?
12.asv: Or if he shall ask an egg, will he give him a scorpion?

13.web: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”
13.asv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

14.web: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.
14.asv: And he was casting out a demon that was dumb. And it came to pass, when the demon was gone out, the dumb man spake; and the multitudes marvelled.

15.web: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”
15.asv: But some of them said, By Beelzebub the prince of the demons casteth he out demons.

16.web: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.
16.asv: And others, trying him, sought of him a sign from heaven.

17.web: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.
17.asv: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.

18.web: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.
18.asv: And if Satan also is divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out demons by Beelzebub.

19.web: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.
19.asv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out demons, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

20.web: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.
20.asv: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then is the kingdom of God come upon you.

21.web: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.
21.asv: When the strong man fully armed guardeth his own court, his goods are in peace:

22.web: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.
22.asv: but when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he taketh from him his whole armor wherein he trusted, and divideth his spoils.

23.web: “He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.
23.asv: He that is not with me is against me; and he that gathereth not with me scattereth.

24.web: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’
24.asv: The unclean spirit when he is gone out of the man, passeth through waterless places, seeking rest, and finding none, he saith, I will turn back unto my house whence I came out.

25.web: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.
25.asv: And when he is come, he findeth it swept and garnished.

26.web: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”
26.asv: Then goeth he, and taketh to him seven other spirits more evil than himself; and they enter in and dwell there: and the last state of that man becometh worse than the first.

27.web: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”
27.asv: And it came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare thee, and the breasts which thou didst suck.

28.web: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”
28.asv: But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word of God, and keep it.

29.web: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.
29.asv: And when the multitudes were gathering together unto him, he began to say, This generation is an evil generation: it seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it but the sign of Jonah.

30.web: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.
30.asv: For even as Jonah became a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.

31.web: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.
31.asv: The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and shall condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, a greater than Solomon is here.

32.web: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.
32.asv: The men of Nineveh shall stand up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, a greater than Jonah is here.

33.web: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.
33.asv: No man, when he hath lighted a lamp, putteth it in a cellar, neither under the bushel, but on the stand, that they which enter in may see the light.

34.web: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.
34.asv: The lamp of thy body is thine eye: when thine eye is single, thy whole body also is full of light; but when it is evil, thy body also is full of darkness.

35.web: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.
35.asv: Look therefore whether the light that is in thee be not darkness.

36.web: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”
36.asv: If therefore thy whole body be full of light, having no part dark, it shall be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining doth give thee light.

37.web: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.
37.asv: Now as he spake, a Pharisee asketh him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to meat.

38.web: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.
38.asv: And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first bathed himself before dinner.

39.web: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.
39.asv: And the Lord said unto him, Now ye the Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter; but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

40.web: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
40.asv: Ye foolish ones, did not he that made the outside make the inside also?

41.web: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.
41.asv: But give for alms those things which are within; and behold, all things are clean unto you.

42.web: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.
42.asv: But woe unto you Pharisees! for ye tithe mint and rue and every herb, and pass over justice and the love of God: but these ought ye to have done, and not to leave the other undone.

43.web: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.
43.asv: Woe unto you Pharisees! for ye love the chief seats in the synagogues, and the salutations in the marketplaces.

44.web: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”
44.asv: Woe unto you! for ye are as the tombs which appear not, and the men that walk over them know it not.

45.web: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”
45.asv: And one of the lawyers answering saith unto him, Teacher, in saying this thou reproachest us also.

46.web: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.
46.asv: And he said, Woe unto you lawyers also! for ye load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and ye yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers.

47.web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
47.asv: Woe unto you! for ye build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

48.web: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.
48.asv: So ye are witnesses and consent unto the works of your fathers: for they killed them, and ye build their tombs.

49.web: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,
49.asv: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send unto them prophets and apostles; and some of them they shall kill and persecute;

50.web: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;
50.asv: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

51.web: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.
51.asv: from the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary: yea, I say unto you, it shall be required of this generation.

52.web: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”
52.asv: Woe unto you lawyers! for ye took away the key of knowledge: ye entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in ye hindered.

53.web: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;
53.asv: And when he was come out from thence, the scribes and the Pharisees began to press upon him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things;

54.web: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.
54.asv: laying wait for him, to catch something out of his mouth.
